facts.text: Iris's tray, carried up to Mr Lockwood.
facts.why: Iris is the carer who raised Maisie and is sent away by Mills, and Lockwood calls for her, but no source or transcript line shows a tray. The note now claims only what she did.
facts.fix: Iris raised Maisie. This tea is for her.

facts.text: Served at the auction before the Indoraptor got out.
facts.why: The auction and the Indoraptor escape are in the film, but no source, transcript line or search result shows oysters or any food served there. Reworded as a joke about the guests.
facts.fix: Fit for the guests at the Lockwood dinosaur auction.

vibe.verdict: Good volcano and Lockwood framing, but a lot of the food is generic.
